seasonRead.headline: 2009–10: The puck runs through the creators
paragraphs: High-Touch Risk/Reward Scorer carries the signature of offensive responsibility: scoring, frequent involvement and more failed plays as the price of attempting difficult ones. The giveaway signal is better read as workload than carelessness.

High-Volume Playmaking Scorer offers a more connective version of creation, with assists and takeaways doing more of the separating. With Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist carrying more block-and-exposure work, the pool shows how creators and support roles divide the burden of a shift.

seasonRead.headline: 2009–10: No single defense job owns the blue line
paragraphs: Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman and Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman are almost level, but they describe opposite shift economies. One tries to move play out of danger; the other is identified by the work that happens when danger has already arrived.

Offensive Puck-Moving Defenseman prevents this from becoming a simple mover-versus-stopper split. In pairing terms, the season offers several ways to distribute puck advancement, shooting-lane work and offensive responsibility.
